The batch therefore emphasizes matched loading and ratio contrasts around these regimes, while retaining compact controls for calibration.","batch_rationale":"The batch combines failure repair for severe basic-aromatic, donor, acid, ester, carbonyl, and completion-tail regions with local response curves for m72, m177, m199, m211, and related scaffolds. Compact m73, m133, m26, m138, and m162 controls constrain overcorrection. This mixture should improve generalization by teaching both where delayed completion is real and where structurally similar rows remain compact across the Row-distribution."}
